decision.interpretation: Bold uppercase 'LUẬT' sits above the specific law title, functioning as the document-type identifier in the title block that opens the substantive content.
Bold uppercase 'GIAO DỊCH ĐIỆN TỬ' is the specific law title following the document-type word, operating at its location to name the law.
Bold 'Chương I' introduces the first substantive chapter of the law at this position, marking the start of the structured body.
Bold 'NHỮNG QUY ĐỊNH CHUNG' serves as the chapter subheading immediately following the chapter number, introducing general provisions.
Bold 'Điều 1. Phạm vi điều chỉnh' marks the start of the first article, naming and opening the scope-defining region of the law.
Bold 'Điều 2. Đối tượng áp dụng' marks the start of the second article, introducing the section defining applicable entities.
Bold 'Điều 3. Giải thích từ ngữ' marks the start of the third article, introducing the statutory definitions region.
